name: Samoa

validation.referee: statute's own printed figures and hand-computed statutory cases (#guard)
validation.notes: annual scale at 25,000 and 26,000; fortnightly tax at 1,000 a fortnight; 26 fortnights; band mismatch

headline: F1 The fortnightly wage-tax bands are not the annual bands: 576 x 26 = 14,976 and 962 x 26 = 25,012, so wage earners and other taxpayers face different thresholds

scale.source: Income Tax Act 2012 Schedule 1 clause (1) (official version as at 31 December 2024): start of the 27 % band ("25,001 + 27%")
scale.basis: Income Tax Act 2012 Schedule 1 clause (1) (official version as at 31 December 2024): start of the 27 % band ("25,001 + 27%"). A statutory threshold, not an average wage: 1 'AW' in scanner output = this amount of annual income.

registry_correction: Registry 'Income Tax Act 2012' confirmed: wages bear a final fortnightly salary and wage income tax (0 % to 576, 20 % to 962, 27 % above, per fortnight); other income at the annual 0/20/27 % (15,000/25,000) scale stacked on wages (s 9(6)); NPF employee 10 %, ACC levy 1 %; dividends from resident companies exempt.
